creativeDirection: Photographic realism: stage the cast in a real mausoleum-like chapel interior rebuilt as a rehearsal space, letting the cemetery sleeve provide the place and the strongest portrait while other covers enter as plausible fixtures, painted surfaces, and objects.
scene: Inside a weathered domed cemetery chapel converted into a stripped-back rehearsal room, the bowed man stands near a large stone cross on worn flagstones while soft late-afternoon light falls from a high window and a few practical lamps pick out instruments, walls, and airborne pigeons near the rafters.

elements.element: the man from reference image 2 standing bowed beside a large stone cross inside a decayed domed chapel with peeling walls and gravestones pushed to the edges
a small live-music setup with microphone stand, guitar amp, drum hardware, and a warm orange-red stage glow worked into the rehearsal space
the large red X-like abstract form painted directly on one worn plaster wall as chapel decoration
several pigeons circling under the dome and a glimpse of apartment blocks through the high window
a white portable music player and a blue floppy disk rendered as actual mascot-like rehearsal-room figurines on an equipment case
brown-green dimness, sheer-curtain cream light, and somber room tone
monochrome contrast in the shadowed edges and bright backlit halo around the space
small accents of sky blue, purple, and sunlit primary colour in scattered equipment details

mood: solemn but alive, haunted rehearsal calm

coverSummaries.people: seven adult performers shown as large portraits and onstage musicians
coverSummaries.place: a live music stage with spotlights, microphones, instruments, and a dark audience-facing performance setup under intense colored lighting.

coverSummaries.description: A solitary adult man in a long dark coat stands with head bowed among gravestones and red vegetation in front of an old domed mausoleum or chapel with columns and peeling walls. A large stone cross stands beside him, and bare branches with reddish leaves frame the scene.

coverSummaries.people: one adult man standing with head bowed in a graveyard
coverSummaries.place: an old cemetery with gravestones, a large stone cross, red ground cover, leafless or sparse trees, and a weathered domed mausoleum with columns.

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white band portrait shows four adults standing close together against a dark background with a bright blown-out light or smoke shape behind them. The central woman wears an off-shoulder cropped top, while the others wear dark clothing; all are lit from behind, creating glowing edges around their hair and shoulders.

coverSummaries.people: four adults standing together in a backlit portrait
coverSummaries.place: a dark studio or stage-like space with strong backlighting and a bright smoky light source behind the group.

coverSummaries.description: A moody interior photograph shows a large window with sheer curtains glowing from daylight outside. In front of it, a dark-haired person bends forward with head lowered, partly silhouetted, while the room around them is dim and brown-green with a hazy, textured overlay.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: bent figure silhouetted before a curtained window
coverSummaries.people: one adult person bent forward in front of a window
coverSummaries.place: a dim room with a tall window, sheer curtains, dark walls, and soft daylight filtering in from outside.

coverSummaries.description: Two anthropomorphic retro tech objects stand side by side on a plain light background: a white music player with a simple face on its screen and a blue floppy disk with a worn metal shutter. Both have cartoon-like arms, gloves, legs, and oversized shoes, with glossy colorful accessories and shadows beneath them.

Various stylized figures gather around steps and a wall, including a flying child holding a round balloon-like sign, seated and standing musicians, robed figures, and other costumed characters in bright patterned clothing.

coverSummaries.description: An abstract graphic cover made of overlapping flat geometric shapes and translucent colour fields. A large red X-like form sits in the center, intersected by green vertical stem shapes with spade-like ends, with broad orange, yellow, blue, pink, and green areas filling the square.

A flock of pigeons flies across a pale sky above modern apartment towers with repeating balconies and glass sections. Blurred branches frame the lower right foreground, and the birds are scattered across the whole composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: flock of pigeons over apartment blocks
coverSummaries.place: an urban residential skyline with tall apartment buildings, stacked balconies, pale overcast sky, and some out-of-focus tree branches in the foreground.

prompt: Inside a weathered domed cemetery chapel converted into a rehearsal room, seen at eye level in a medium-long 16:9 view, the camera close enough to clearly read the face and bowed posture of the man from reference image 2. He stands near the left-middle of the frame beside a tall stone cross on worn flagstones, keeping his original lowered head, dark coat, stillness, and grave expression, with peeling cream walls, shallow side chapels, and the curve of the dome around him. Build the place primarily from reference image 2 as a real mausoleum interior, but add from reference image 1 a plausible live-music setup: a microphone stand, a guitar leaning by a small amp, partial drum hardware and cables, and a restrained orange-red performance glow from practical stage bulbs in the room. Add from reference image 7 a large red X-like geometric form painted directly onto one cracked plaster wall, faded and integrated as architectural decoration rather than graphic art. Add from reference image 8 several pigeons circling below the dome and a high window revealing pale apartment blocks outside. Add from reference image 5 a white music player figurine and a blue floppy-disk figurine standing on a road case as quirky real mascot objects, small and secondary. Use the brown-green dimness and curtained cream light mood of reference image 4 only as atmosphere, and the black-white backlit contrast of reference image 3 only as tonal shaping around edges; take small blue, purple, and primary-colour accents from reference image 6 only in minor equipment details. Realistic editorial location photography, crisp and clean, no collage look, no haze, no heavy grain. Off-centre portrait with open space to the right, layered but not symmetrical, faces properly lit, textures sharp, late-afternoon skylight from a high window mixed with a few warm rehearsal lamps so the cast face and all sleeve colours remain legible. Palette of stone gray, oxblood red, burnt orange, dusty cream, brown-green, and muted blue; solemn, strange, quietly musical. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 2 shows one adult man standing with head bowed in a graveyard. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, bone structure, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Nobody from reference images 1, 3, 4 appears in the picture: use those images only for colour, setting, and objects, and add no figures, faces, or silhouettes from them. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails, posters, record covers, or pictures on a screen, monitor, or television. A sleeve's abstract graphics, shapes, patterns, and colours may be painted onto the walls, doors, floor, or objects of the place as part of its decoration, without any lettering. Show no sleeve's faces, heads, or figures as a picture, mural, display, sign, relief, or silhouette anywhere; transform the sleeves' non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling, and their apparent age: every person is shown as the adult they are on the sleeve, never younger, smoothed, or more boyish or girlish. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image cleanly whatever the light: every person's face well lit and readable, shadows that hold detail, and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Add no incidental plants: no flowers, potted plants, planters, climbing vines, ivy, hanging foliage, hedges, lawns, flower beds, or greenery framing the edges or carpeting the floor, unless the description above explicitly asks for that plant as part of a source motif or the year treatment. Dress the scene with the materials of the place itself - stone, metal, concrete, wood, fabric, glass, water, equipment - rather than vegetation. Everyone in the picture is photographed in the same place, at the same moment, under the same light as the rest of the scene, in full colour and with the same lens and grain: do not carry over a sleeve's own backdrop, studio lighting, backlit flare, monochrome, colour cast, or print texture onto the person. Each person stands inside the scene at the scale of the space around them, never as an oversized cropped head or bust looming at the edge of the frame over a distant scene, and never washed in red, blue, or other coloured light. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere. The only people anywhere in the image are the reference people named in the reference map, and of those only the ones whose faces are clearly visible in their reference. Add no one else: no extra band members, musicians, staff, bystanders, passers-by, crowd, audience, background or out-of-focus figures, and no hands, arms, legs, or shadows of unseen people. Never complete a person who is hidden, cropped, turned away, blurred, or only partly visible in a reference with an invented face or body - leave that person out entirely. Photograph the reference people from roughly eye level, at three-quarter length or closer, in the near or middle ground, so each of their faces is large, sharp, and clearly recognisable in the final frame: never from directly above, and never as small distant figures.
